user.title: New OORT zone
user.description: A zone is one HVAC system and the rooms it serves. Next you'll add its rooms and, optionally, people.

data_description.name: Used in entity IDs, e.g. "Home" gives sensor.oort_home_temperature.

menu.title: Zone setup

defaults.title: Defaults
defaults.description: Settings used by every room in this zone unless the room overrides them. A **tau** is a time in minutes: roughly how long a room's weight takes to get two-thirds of the way to its new value. **Weights** say how much each room counts.

data_description.tau_person_rise: Minutes for a room's weight to move most of the way up to the person weight once a tracked person is in it. Smaller reacts faster; larger is smoother. Default 3.
data_description.tau_person_fall: Minutes for the weight to fall back after the last tracked person leaves. Larger keeps the room counted during short trips out. Default 3.
data_description.tau_occupancy_rise: Minutes to move up to the occupied weight once an occupancy sensor or template says someone is there (and no tracked person is). Default 10.
data_description.tau_occupancy_fall: Minutes to fall back after occupancy ends. Default 8.
data_description.tau_deactivate: Minutes for a room to fade out when it becomes "open" (an opening entity turns on or the opening template turns true). 0 = instantly. Default 1.
data_description.tau_dropout: Minutes for a room to fade out when its temperature sensor becomes unavailable. 0 = instantly. Default 5.
data_description.w_person: How much a room with a tracked person in it counts. Only the ratios between the weights matter. Default 1.0.
data_description.w_occupied: How much an occupied room counts (sensor or template says someone is there, no tracked person). Default 0.5.
data_description.w_base: How much an empty room counts. Keep it tiny so empty rooms barely move the temperature. Must be at least 0.001. Default 0.001.
data_description.stale_limit: Minutes a room's last reading is still used after its temperature sensor drops out; after that the room is left out. Default 5.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Pick a room to edit or remove, add a new one, or choose Done.

data_description.room: Pick a room to edit or remove it, "Add a new room" to add one, or "Done" to go back to the menu.

room.title: Add room
room.description: Each room is a Home Assistant area with its own temperature sensor.

data_description.area_id: The Home Assistant area this room is. It can't be changed later.
data_description.temperature_sensor: The sensor measuring this room's temperature.
data_description.occupancy_sensors: The room counts as occupied while any of these is on.
data_description.occupancy_template: When true, the room also counts as occupied.
data_description.opening_sensors: The room is left out while any of these is on, like a window or door being open (its weight fades to 0). Unavailable counts as closed.
data_description.opening_template: When it renders true (true, on, yes, enable, or any number other than 0), the room is also left out. Anything else, including unavailable, unknown or an error, counts as false.

data_description.tau_dropout: Minutes for a room to fade out when its temperature sensor becomes unavailable. 0 = instantly. Leave blank to use the zone's default.
data_description.w_person: How much a room with a tracked person in it counts. Only the ratios between the weights matter. Leave blank to use the zone's default.
data_description.w_occupied: How much an occupied room counts (sensor or template says someone is there, no tracked person). Leave blank to use the zone's default.
data_description.w_base: How much an empty room counts. Keep it tiny so empty rooms barely move the temperature. Must be at least 0.001. Leave blank to use the zone's default.

people.title: People
people.description: People are optional. Pick one to edit or remove, add a new one, or choose Done.

data_description.person: Pick a person to edit or remove them, "Add a new person" to add one, or "Done" to go back to the menu.

person.title: Person

data_description.name: Shown in each room's people attribute while this person is there.
data_description.source_entity: An entity whose state, or one of its attributes (next step), is the area this person is in.
data_description.remove: Removes the person from this zone when you submit.

person.description: Who to track, and which entity says where they are.

data_description.source_attribute: Leave blank to use the entity's state. Otherwise pick the attribute that holds the area.
data_description.value_type: Whether the value is the area's name (for example "Living Room") or its ID (for example "living_room").
